description: Submit thumbs up/down feedback on a generated image, with an optional credit-back on a thumbs-down (subject to the API's eligibility rules).

creditBack.description: Request a credit refund (only honored on a thumbs-down).

imageId.description: Explicit image id. One of imageUrl/imageId is required.

imageUrl.description: The generated image URL to vote on (id is parsed from it).

vote.description: Thumbs up/down. An empty string clears a previous vote.

name: pedra_feedback
title: Submit feedback
